hero.title: Forge your next <gradient>Vintage Story</gradient> adventure.
hero.description: Story Forge is a fast, open-source launcher and mod manager for Vintage Story — profiles, mods, modpacks, world maps and server hosting, all in one place.

features.title: Everything the launcher should have been
features.description: Built for Vintage Story players who would rather be playing than fixing their mod folder.

profiles.title: Profiles that stay tidy
profiles.description: Keep separate mod sets and worlds for every server or playthrough. Clone, rename, export and import in seconds.

mods.title: Mods without the mess
mods.description: Browse the entire Vintage Story ModDB, search by version and tag, and update everything in one click.

modpacks.title: Community modpacks
modpacks.description: Publish, discover and install community modpacks. Story Forge resolves every mod and config for you.

versions.title: Every game version
versions.description: Install any Vintage Story release straight from the official CDN — and link builds you already have.

maps.title: World map viewer
maps.description: Open your world saves as an interactive map and share them with your friends.

hosting.title: Server hosting
hosting.description: Host a dedicated Vintage Story server with the same profile — no command line required.

showcase.title: Built like a tool, not a toy
showcase.description: Sharp, fast and keyboard-friendly — the same interface power users have been asking for.
showcase.captionMods: The full ModDB, with one-click updates
showcase.captionModConfigs: Edit mod configs without leaving the app
showcase.captionVersions: Every game version, one click away
showcase.captionWorlds: Explore your worlds as a map

modpacks.title: Community modpacks, ready to play
modpacks.description: Curated packs published by the community. Install them straight from Story Forge and jump in.

download.title: Download Story Forge
download.description: Free and open source for Windows, macOS and Linux.
download.descriptionWithVersion: Latest release {{version}} — free and open source for Windows, macOS and Linux.

openSource.title: Built in the open
openSource.description: Story Forge is GPLv3-licensed and developed in public. Read the source, report bugs, request features or send a pull request — every contribution makes the launcher better.

finalCta.title: Ready to forge your story?
finalCta.description: Join thousands of Vintage Story players who manage their mods, worlds and servers with Story Forge.
